Privacy Policy

Last Updated: February 5, 2026

Florence Mae Gifts, LLC ("we," "us," or "our") operates the website https://www.florencemaegifts.com (the "Site"). This Privacy Policy describes how we collect, use, and share information when you visit the Site.

Information We Collect
We do not directly collect personal information through the Site. However, when you use our contact form, you voluntarily provide your name, email address, and message content. This information is processed and delivered to us via our website email service provider.

Cookies and Tracking
The Site uses browser localStorage to remember your theme preference (light or dark mode). We do not use tracking cookies. Third-party services embedded on the Site (such as Google Fonts and Font Awesome) may collect usage data in accordance with their own privacy policies.

Third-Party Links
The Site contains links to third-party websites including Instagram, Etsy, and Facebook. We are not responsible for the privacy practices of these external sites. We encourage you to review their privacy policies.

Children's Privacy
The Site is not directed at children under 13. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children.

Changes to This Policy
We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. Any changes will be reflected on this page with an updated date.

Contact Us
If you have questions about this Privacy Policy, please contact us through the contact form on our Site or through our social media channels.
